dialogue.speaker: bec
text: You were just about to extract some precious cargo from this poor bastard's chest cavity.

dialogue.speaker: bec
text: But now you and the would-be corpse seem to have been whisked away far beyond the reaches of paradox space.

dialogue.speaker: bec
text: And powers far greater than yours are making you sing first, stab later.
Is that broad in red forcing this?

dialogue.speaker: bec
text: You swear you'll wring her goddamn neck once your tune has been carried.
